# amplience_extension (Resource)

Manages an Amplience Extension. Extensions are UI components embedded in Dynamic Content to provide custom editing experiences.

For more info see [Amplience Extensions Docs](https://amplience.com/docs/development/extensions.html)

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "amplience_extension" "example" {
  name                          = "extension-01"
  label                         = "Extension-01 first-draft"
  description                   = "This is a description of an extension."
  url                           = "https://example.com"
  height                        = 400
  enabled_for_all_content_types = false
  category                      = "CONTENT_FIELD"

  settings = jsonencode({
    API = {
      READ = true
      EDIT = true
    }
    SANDBOX = {
      SAME_ORIGIN          = true
      MODALS               = false
      NAVIGATION           = false
      POPUPS               = true
      POPUP_ESCAPE_SANDBOX = false
      DOWNLOADS            = false
      FORMS                = false
    }
  })

  parameters = jsonencode({
    color = "blue"
  })

  snippets = [
    {
      label = "my snippet"
      body  = jsonencode({})
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `category` (String) Extension category (CONTENT_FIELD, DASHBOARD, or CONTENT_EDITOR). Determines which other attributes are applicable
- `label` (String) Extension label displayed in the UI
- `name` (String) Extension name
- `url` (String) URL of the extension

### Optional

- `description` (String) Extension description
- `enabled_for_all_content_types` (Boolean) Whether this extension is enabled for all content types. Only applicable for CONTENT_EDITOR category
- `height` (Number) Height of the extension iframe in pixels. Only applicable for CONTENT_FIELD category
- `parameters` (String) Extension parameters as a JSON object string, e.g. jsonencode({vendor = "commercetools"})
- `settings` (String) Extension settings as a JSON string
- `snippets` (Attributes List) Extension snippets. Only applicable for CONTENT_FIELD category (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--snippets))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--snippets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `snippets`

Required:

- `body` (String) Snippet body as a JSON string
- `label` (String) Snippet label
